meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把散落在 .env 里的密钥搬进统一保险库,并完成命令行工具的首次初始化配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你刚装好命令行工具,想把项目里的密钥从 .env 收进保险库
copy.tagline_en: Migrate scattered .env credentials into a managed vault and finish first-time setup
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed a CLI tool and want its .env secrets moved into a vault

howto.what: Claude 会安装并初始化 OneCLI Agent Vault、配置其网关,把 .env 里的 Anthropic 等凭据迁移进 vault,并从 .env 删掉原始密钥,最后重新构建、重启服务、查日志确认生效。
howto.when: 在 /update-nanoclaw 把 OneCLI 作为破坏性变更引入之后,或首次从零搭建 OneCLI 时触发;若 package.json 里没有 @onecli-sh/sdk,它会先让你跑 /update-nanoclaw。

say.text: 帮我初始化 OneCLI,把 .env 里的凭据迁移进去
检查一下 OneCLI 现在装好了吗,能不能用
重新配置 OneCLI,重新注册凭据

howto.what_en: Claude installs and initializes OneCLI Agent Vault, configures its gateway, migrates credentials from .env into the vault, removes the raw keys from .env, then rebuilds, restarts the service and checks logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup. If @onecli-sh/sdk is missing from package.json, it asks you to run /update-nanoclaw first.

say_en.note: Checks current state first, then migrates

say_en.text: Check whether OneCLI is installed and working
say_en.note: Runs onecli version and secrets list
